events.did: popped the cork of the champagne and poured herself a very large glass to celebrate having hacked an EO body
events.quote_anchor: Dani popped the cork and poured herself a very large glass.

events.did: opened the door and found Victor standing there with blood on the hand pressed to his side
events.quote_anchor: she saw the sheen of sweat on Victor’s skin, the blood staining his hand where it was pressed against his side, his gritted teeth

events.did: stormed past her into the house, growling that the compound doesn't work
events.quote_anchor: “The compound doesn’t work,” he growled, storming past her into the house.

events.did: unearthed the first aid kit and sorted through it until she found a suture set
events.quote_anchor: She sorted through it until she found a suture set.

events.did: took the kit from her hand and stitched the cut closed without flinching when the needle pierced his skin
events.quote_anchor: He didn’t even flinch when the needle pierced skin, when the thread caught on its torn edges, tugging them together.

events.did: told Dani how he had cornered the four men in the lot, taken down the first two, and felt the pain flare up against the third
events.quote_anchor: how he had cornered the four men in the lot, how he’d taken down the first two, been testing his power against the third when the pain flared up

events.did: transferred the data from his heart monitor onto her laptop and scowled at the results
events.quote_anchor: she transferred the data from his heart monitor onto her laptop and scowled at the results

events.did: left Dani's house while she was fetching blankets for the couch, and took the rest of her champagne
events.quote_anchor: And he’d taken the rest of her champagne.

relations.did: Dani had been putting time and effort into fixing Victor over the last three months; he was her experiment
relations.quote_anchor: given the time and effort she’d put into fixing him over the last three months

relations.did: Dani told Victor that the damage to his heart sets a hard limit on what his restored power can do
relations.quote_anchor: the damage it must have done to your heart is quite frankly hard to fathom

relations.did: Jeremy is Dani's brother, a pilot; they are not close but are all each other has left
relations.quote_anchor: We’re not that close, but we’re all we have left, so I’m there if he needs me, and he’s there if I need him…

relations.did: the dean tanked Dani's career out of wounded pride; the champagne was a gift from the head of the chemistry department
relations.quote_anchor: A gift from the head of the chemistry department—not to be confused with the dean who’d tanked her career, just because she hurt his pride.

numbers.did: how long she had been living in the faculty house: three years
numbers.quote_anchor: Three years she’d been living in this place, one of the many houses reserved for faculty in the blocks surrounding Lockland’s campus.

numbers.did: the time she had spent fixing Victor: the last three months
numbers.quote_anchor: given the time and effort she’d put into fixing him over the last three months

numbers.did: how long he had been gone before he showed up at her door: an hour and a half
numbers.quote_anchor: “Jesus Christ, Victor, you were gone for an hour and a half.”

numbers.did: the number of doses of the drug she gave Victor: one
numbers.quote_anchor: Which is why I didn’t give you more than one dose.

numbers.did: the number of men Victor cornered in the lot: four
numbers.quote_anchor: how he had cornered the four men in the lot, how he’d taken down the first two

numbers.did: the number of the men Victor took down before testing his power on the third: the first two
numbers.quote_anchor: how he’d taken down the first two, been testing his power against the third when the pain flared up
